name: Tzniut Content Filter
description: Enforces community modesty (tzniut) standards by filtering text content and moderating uploaded images.

settings_schema.header: Configure the Tzniut Content Filter to enforce community standards for text and image content.
settings_schema.footer: Flagged content is routed to the configured moderator channel for human review.

settings.help_text: A comma-separated list of words or phrases to block. Supports basic regex patterns.
off: No image scanning. flag: Send uploaded images to the moderator channel for review. block: Reject all image uploads until reviewed.
The channel ID where flagged content is reported. The channel must exist and the plugin bot must be a member.
When enabled, blocked messages are silently dropped instead of returning an error to the sender.
